source: de Chazal, O'Dwyer & Reilly, 'Automatic Classification of Heartbeats Using ECG Morphology and Heartbeat Interval Features', IEEE TBME, 2004
note: Split is at the PATIENT/RECORD level, not the beat level. No record in ds1 may ever appear in ds2, and vice versa. Records in 'excluded' are left out entirely (paced-beat patients, not compliant with AAMI EC57 evaluation).

expected_counts.note_on_beat_counts: Reported total beats vary slightly by source depending on annotation-symbol mapping (~51,000 in DS1, ~49,700 in DS2 is the commonly cited range). Treat as a sanity-check range, not an exact target, since your own counting logic may legitimately differ by a small margin depending on how you map annotation symbols to AAMI classes.
